text.id: Selamat malam. Mohon maaf mengganggu. Saya Aditya, dari bagian community relations PT Bentang Pesisir Makmur.
text.en: Good evening. I'm sorry to bother you. My name is Aditya, from community relations at PT Bentang Pesisir Makmur.

text.id: Nomor ini saya dapat dari Mas Bima. Beliau sangat khawatir. Kami semua turut prihatin atas hilangnya Mbak Sekar.
text.en: I got this number from Bima. He is very worried. All of us are deeply sorry about Ms. Sekar's disappearance.

text.id: "Bentang Pesisir," kata Dinda pelan. "PT. B."
text.en: "Bentang Pesisir," Dinda says quietly. "PT. B."

text.id: Aditya. Orang-orang panggil dia Pak Didit. Ibu-ibu kerang bilang senyumnya kebanyakan.
text.en: Aditya. People call him Pak Didit. The mussel women said he smiles too much.

text.id: Orang PR dari perusahaan yang nawarin sponsor. Yang nelpon Tasya malem-malem. Ramah banget. Terlalu ramah.
text.en: The PR man from the company that offered the sponsorship. The one who called Tasya late at night. So friendly. Too friendly.

text.id: Saya juga dengar grup pendengar Mbak Sekar sempat ramai kemarin pagi. Pasti berat sekali untuk Anda.
text.en: I also heard Ms. Sekar's listener group got rather busy yesterday morning. This must be very hard for you.

text.id: Perusahaan kami ingin membantu. Kami punya pengacara, dan kami bekerja sama dengan laboratorium forensik digital. Kalau HP Mbak Sekar bisa diperiksa dengan benar, mungkin ada petunjuk yang terlewat oleh polisi.
text.en: Our company would like to help. We have lawyers, and we work with a digital forensics lab. If Ms. Sekar's phone could be examined properly, there might be clues the police have missed.

text.id: Kurir kami bisa datang ke rumah malam ini, jam delapan. Aman, ada tanda terimanya. Besok pagi hasilnya sudah ada.
text.en: Our courier can come to the house tonight at eight. It's safe, with a signed receipt. You'd have the results by tomorrow morning.

text.id: Salam untuk Dik Dinda juga, ya. Pasti berat sekali untuk adiknya.
text.en: Please give my regards to Dinda too. This must be so hard for the younger sister.

text.id: Gue nggak pernah nyebut nama Dinda ke siapa pun di luar rumah ini.
text.en: I've never said Dinda's name to anyone outside this house.

text.id: "Jangan kasih ke siapa pun yang tiba-tiba baik sama kamu."
text.en: "Don't hand it to anyone who's suddenly nice to you."

text.id: Dinda megang lengan gue. Kenceng. "Jangan," katanya. Cuma itu.
text.en: Dinda grips my arm. Hard. "Don't," she says. That's all.

text.id: Dinda ngelihat layar, terus ngelihat gue. Dia nggak ngomong apa-apa. Sejak kemarin, dia mulai nunggu gue yang mutusin sendiri.
text.en: Dinda looks at the screen, then at me. She doesn't say anything. Since yesterday, she's started leaving the decisions to me.

text.id: Bagaimana, Mas Raka? Kurirnya saya jalankan?
text.en: So, Raka? Shall I send the courier?

text.id: Gimana?
text.en: Well?

text.id: Kirim HP-nya lewat kurir.
text.en: Send the phone with the courier.

text.id: "Saya pikir-pikir dulu, Pak."
text.en: "Let me think about it first."

text.id: Tunjukin sesuatu ke dia.
text.en: Show him something.

text.id: (Nggak bales.)
text.en: (Don't reply.)

text.id: Iya, Pak. Silakan kirim kurirnya.
text.en: Yes. Please send the courier.

text.id: Saya pikir-pikir dulu, Pak.
text.en: Let me think about it first.

text.id: Kirim apa ke dia?
text.en: What do you send him?

text.id: Astaga. Saya turut prihatin ada yang mengirim pesan seperti itu, Mas.
text.en: Good heavens. I'm sorry someone sent you a message like that.

text.id: Saran saya sebagai teman, sebaiknya Anda berhenti dulu. Demi keluarganya.
text.en: My advice, as a friend, is that you stop for now. For the family's sake.

text.id: "Demi keluarganya." Gue taruh layarnya di samping screenshot pesan tengah malem itu. "Demi adiknya."
text.en: "For the family's sake." I put the screen next to the screenshot of the midnight message. "For her sister's sake."

text.id: Dinda baca dua-duanya, terus ngelihat gue. Nggak ada yang perlu ngomong.
text.en: Dinda reads them both, then looks at me. Neither of us needs to say it.

text.id: Aditya sedang mengetik...
text.en: Aditya is typing...

text.id: Aditya terakhir dilihat 19.26
text.en: Aditya last seen 7:26 PM

text.id: Dia berhenti ngetik. Dia nggak pernah ngirim apa-apa lagi.
text.en: He stops typing. He never sends anything else.

text.id: Terima kasih sudah memberi tahu saya, Mas. Justru hal-hal seperti ini yang bisa diperiksa lab kami.
text.en: Thank you for sharing. That's exactly the kind of thing our lab can look into.

text.id: Tentu. Silakan dipikirkan baik-baik. Tapi tawaran seperti ini tidak selalu ada, Mas.
text.en: Of course. Please think it over carefully. But an offer like this won't always be there.

text.id: Selamat malam.
text.en: Good evening.

text.id: Jam delapan lewat. Nggak ada motor yang berhenti di depan pagar. Tapi gue tetep ngintip dari jendela atas, dua kali, kayak Sekar dulu.
text.en: Eight o'clock comes and goes. No motorbike stops at the gate. But I still look out of the upstairs window, twice, the way Sekar used to.
